subject: Important update regarding your upcoming flight
body: Dear valued customer, We wanted to inform you about a change in your upcoming flight schedule. Due to unforeseen circumstances, there has been a slight adjustment to your departure time. Your new flight details are as follows: Flight: XYZ123 Date: DD/MM/YYYY Departure Time: HH:MM We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. Should you have any questions or require further assistance, please don't hesitate to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you on board!
